other_conditions: Disability percentage must be 40% or more
Student must be studying in Class 11 or higher at a recognized government or private educational institution
Student must be enrolled as a regular student in a minimum two‑year diploma course at a Government Higher Secondary School, College, or Polytechnic College
At least five eligible girls or five eligible boys are required to avail student‑home facilities
benefits_summary: Provides up to ₹750 per month as rent assistance and ₹1,000 per month for electricity and water charges for eligible disabled students staying in hostels.
application_link: Submit the application in prescribed format to the District Office of Social Justice and Disabled Welfare.
